decision_record.calculation: Filter fixtures: long break, target 512.30 — spot 515.00 -> refused, spot 505.00 -> enters; short break, target 487.70 — spot 485.00 -> refused. Switch OFF -> the consumed long enters, exactly pre-change.
decision_record.comparison: Pre-change rule: a signal stays actionable for ENTRY_FRESH_S (1800s) with no re-check of where spot stands against the setup's own target; the sleeve evaluates every 60s, so a break at 10:00 can be entered at 10:29 with the target already touched.
decision_record.experiment: Filter-level A/B on translated intent dicts in the sleeve's exact reason format (entry production oracle-covered by the port suite): consumed/unconsumed/short/OFF cases above.
decision_record.mechanism: Execution timing: at the adapter layer, refuse an entry intent whose price_hint (the spot the sleeve itself picked the contract off) has already reached the target parsed from the intent's own reason (break: the next map line; fade: the magnet), in the trade's direction.
decision_record.transfer: The Three-Ticker Break is paid the room between the break and the next map line (>= 8 SPX points of room and >= 1R are entry conditions). That room is the trade; once spot has consumed it, the buyer of a 0DTE contract pays full premium for a move that already happened.

switch: extra.em_1587_enh2.target_consumed default ON; OFF restores the freshness-only rule exactly
